plainLanguage: Section 46 inahusu kusaidia, kuabet au kuwa accessory to mutiny, na pia kuchochea member wa vyombo vilivyotajwa kufanya sedition au kutotii lawful order ya superior officer.
meaning: The section creates liability through participation in mutiny and through specified incitement to sedition or disobedience of a lawful superior order.
keyPoints: Aiding, abetting and accessory liability are expressly included.
The mutiny must involve a member of a listed service or other law-enforcement organ.
Paragraph (b) covers incitement to sedition or disobedience to a lawful superior order.
The current text creates the offence; any penalty must be determined from applicable law rather than invented.

legalTerms.meaning: Aina za participation katika offence zilizotajwa moja kwa moja na section.
Amri ya superior officer ambayo ni halali; legality is part of the wording.

examples.title: Element check
examples.scenario: Prosecution allegation is assessed against the exact wording of this section.
examples.analysis: Kila statutory element lazima ithibitishwe; label ya offence peke yake haitoshi.

history.summary: Section 46 forms part of Chapter VII, Treason and Other Offences Against the Republic.
notes: Official wording checked against the R.E. 2022 source before explanation.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo A
expertPerspectives.view: Analysis should follow the exact statutory verbs and mental elements rather than a broad description of the alleged conduct.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo B
expertPerspectives.view: The evidence should be matched separately to each required element and any express qualification in the provision.

debateQuestion: Je, evidence inayodaiwa inathibitisha kila element ya section 46 bila kupanua wording ya statute?
disclaimer: Ufafanuzi huu si maandishi rasmi ya sheria.
